summary: TALLE MUSIC PRODUCTION (org. no. 886 947 542) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Sogndal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-06-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 59.200 (Produksjon og utgivelse av musikk- og lydopptak); it has 0 registered employees.
